title: Add verified save feedback to Memory
context: MemoryScreen previously cleared the user's draft before the async persistence operation completed and showed no visible save state.
goal: Show progress and only clear the Memory draft when the refreshed snapshot contains the saved item.
forbidden_changes: Do not change memory storage/runtime semantics.
Do not claim persistence success without a matching item in the refreshed snapshot.
Do not add sensitive data to logs.
acceptance_criteria: Prevent repeated save taps while a save is running.
Keep the draft unless persistence is visible in the refreshed snapshot.
Show Vietnamese progress, verified-success, or unverified-save status.
verification: Run Agent Task Contract, M3 and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA.
Verify persistence across a screen revisit on device.
recovery: Revert this task commit if save feedback misreports persistence or loses the draft.
